title.sk: Špagety bolonské s pomaly duseným ragú

description.sk: Mäsové ragú s vínom a mliekom, dusené hodinu a pol, kým nie je husté a sladké.
description.en: A meat ragù with wine and milk, simmered for an hour and a half until thick and sweet.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, mrkvu a zeler nakrájaj na veľmi drobné kocky, cesnak nadrobno. V širokom hrnci rozohrej olej a zeleninu na ňom pomaly opekaj na miernom ohni 10 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezačne sladnúť.
steps.en: Dice the onion, carrot and celery very finely and chop the garlic. Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables gently over a low heat for 10 minutes until soft and sweet.

steps.sk: Zvýš oheň, pridaj obe mäsá a opekaj ich 8 minút, kým sa šťava neodparí a mäso nezačne hnednúť. Hrudky rozbíjaj vareškou, aby bolo ragú jemné.
steps.en: Turn up the heat, add both meats and fry for 8 minutes until the juices evaporate and the meat starts to brown. Break up the lumps with a wooden spoon so the ragù is fine.

steps.sk: Prilej víno a var, kým takmer nevyvrie, potom pridaj mlieko a nechaj ho tiež odpariť – mlieko mäso zjemní. Vmiešaj pretlak, paradajky, bobkový list, lyžičku soli a korenie.
steps.en: Pour in the wine and boil until it has almost gone, then add the milk and let that bubble away too; it makes the meat tender. Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes, bay leaf, a teaspoon of salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Ragú var na najmenšom ohni pod pootvorenou pokrievkou 1,5 hodiny a občas premiešaj; keď je príliš husté, prilej trochu vody. Hotové je husté a tmavočervené a tuk sa na povrchu oddeľuje.
steps.en: Simmer the ragù on the lowest heat with the lid ajar for 1½ hours, stirring now and then and adding a little water if it gets too thick. It is ready when thick and deep red, with the fat separating on the surface.

steps.sk: Špagety uvar vo veľkom hrnci vriacej vody so zvyšnou soľou o minútu kratšie, než je na obale. Odober si šálku vody z cestovín, špagety sceď a premiešaj ich priamo v ragú s trochou tejto vody.
steps.en: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of boiling water with the remaining salt for a minute less than the packet says. Save a cup of the pasta water, drain the spaghetti and toss it straight into the ragù with a splash of that water.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané strúhaným parmezánom. Ragú vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a v mrazničke 3 mesiace – oplatí sa uvariť dvojitú dávku a použiť ju aj na lasagne.
steps.en: Serve topped with grated parmesan. The ragù keeps in the fridge for 4 days and in the freezer for 3 months, so a double batch is worth making for lasagne too.

title.sk: Pasta e fagioli – hustá polievka s cestovinami a fazuľou
title.en: Pasta e fagioli: thick pasta and bean soup

description.sk: Talianska sedliacka polievka z fazule, zeleniny a drobných cestovín, hustá ako guláš.
description.en: An Italian peasant soup of beans, vegetables and small pasta, as thick as a stew.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, mrkvu a zeler nakrájaj na drobné kocky a cesnak nadrobno. Fazuľu sceď a prepláchni; tretinu z nej roztlač vidličkou na kašu, ktorá polievku zahustí.
steps.en: Dice the onion, carrot and celery small and chop the garlic finely. Drain and rinse the beans and mash a third of them with a fork; the mash thickens the soup.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja a zeleninu na ňom opekaj na miernom ohni 8 minút do mäkka. Pridaj cesnak, rozmarín a čili a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pot and cook the vegetables over a low heat for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, rosemary and chilli and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, celú aj roztlačenú fazuľu, 1 liter vody a rozdrobený bujón, priveď do varu a var 10 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, the whole and mashed beans, 1 litre of water and the crumbled stock cube, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Vsyp cestoviny a var za občasného miešania podľa času na obale, zvyčajne 10 minút, kým nie sú mäkké. Polievka má byť hustá ako guláš; ak je príliš hustá, dolej vodu. Dochuť soľou a korením.
steps.en: Add the pasta and cook, stirring now and then, for the time on the packet, usually 10 minutes, until tender. The soup should be as thick as a stew; add water if it is too thick. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Rozlej ju do tanierov, pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom a podľa chuti posyp parmezánom. Cestoviny pri státí nasajú tekutinu, preto pri ohrievaní prilej vodu; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Ladle into bowls, drizzle with the remaining oil and add parmesan if you like. The pasta soaks up liquid as it stands, so add water when reheating; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Pasta e ceci – cestoviny s cícerom a rozmarínom
title.en: Pasta e ceci: pasta with chickpeas and rosemary

description.sk: Krémový rímsky cícer s cestovinami, cesnakom, rozmarínom a citrónom – jedlo na lyžicu.
description.en: Creamy Roman-style chickpeas with pasta, garlic, rosemary and lemon, eaten with a spoon.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a cesnak nakrájaj nadrobno, cícer sceď a prepláchni. V hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja a cibuľu na ňom speň 5 minút, potom pridaj cesnak, rozmarín, čili a pretlak a miešaj 1 minútu.
steps.en: Chop the onion and garlic finely; drain and rinse the chickpeas. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pot and soften the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, rosemary, chilli and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer, 900 ml vody a rozdrobený bujón a var 10 minút. Potom asi tretinu cíceru s trochou vody rozmixuj ponorným mixérom a vráť do hrnca, vznikne krémový základ.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas, 900 ml water and the crumbled stock cube and simmer for 10 minutes. Then blend about a third of the chickpeas with a little of the liquid using a stick blender and return it to the pot for a creamy base.

steps.sk: Vsyp cestoviny a var ich priamo v hrnci podľa času na obale. Často miešaj až po dno, lebo škrob z cestovín sa rád prichytí; ak zhustne priveľmi, prilej horúcu vodu.
steps.en: Add the pasta and cook it right in the pot for the time on the packet. Stir often, right to the bottom, as the pasta starch likes to catch; if it gets too thick, add hot water.

steps.sk: Odstav hrniec, vmiešaj citrónovú šťavu, petržlenovú vňať, soľ a korenie. Jedlo má byť hustejšie než polievka, ale riedšie než omáčka – Taliani ho jedia lyžicou.
steps.en: Take the pot off the heat and stir in the lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper. It should be thicker than a soup but looser than a sauce; Italians eat it with a spoon.

steps.sk: Podávaj pokvapkané zvyšným olejom a s čerstvo mletým korením. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni; pri ohrievaní prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Serve drizzled with the remaining oil and plenty of freshly ground pepper. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; add a little water when reheating.

title.sk: Cacio e pepe – špagety so syrom a čiernym korením
title.en: Cacio e pepe: spaghetti with cheese and black pepper

description.sk: Tri suroviny a trocha techniky: krémová omáčka zo syra, korenia a škrobovej vody z cestovín.
description.en: Three ingredients and a little technique: a creamy sauce of cheese, pepper and starchy pasta water.

steps.sk: Parmezán nastrúhaj čo najjemnejšie – hrubý syr sa nerozpustí a vytvorí hrudky. Korenie nahrubo podrv v mažiari alebo dnom panvice.
steps.en: Grate the parmesan as finely as you can; coarse cheese will not melt and turns lumpy. Coarsely crush the peppercorns in a mortar or with the base of a pan.

steps.sk: Špagety var v menšom množstve vody, asi v 1,5 litri, so soľou o 2 minúty kratšie, než je na obale. Menej vody znamená viac škrobu, ktorý omáčku spojí. Pred scedením si odober 250 ml vody z cestovín.
steps.en: Cook the spaghetti in less water than usual, about 1.5 litres, with the salt, for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Less water means more starch to bind the sauce. Save 250 ml of the pasta water before draining.

steps.sk: Na širokej panvici opraž korenie nasucho 1 minútu, kým nezavonia, pridaj maslo a 100 ml vody z cestovín a nechaj zovrieť. Pridaj scedené špagety a 1 až 2 minúty ich v tekutine prehadzuj, kým nie sú al dente.
steps.en: Toast the pepper in a dry, wide frying pan for 1 minute until fragrant, add the butter and 100 ml of the pasta water and bring to the boil. Add the drained spaghetti and toss it in the liquid for 1 to 2 minutes until al dente.

steps.sk: Stiahni panvicu z ohňa a nechaj ju 30 sekúnd vychladnúť, príliš horúca panvica by syr zrazila. Postupne prisýpaj parmezán, rýchlo miešaj kliešťami a prilievaj vodu z cestovín, kým nevznikne hladká, lesklá omáčka.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and let it cool for 30 seconds, as a pan that is too hot makes the cheese clump. Add the parmesan a little at a time, tossing fast with tongs and adding pasta water until you have a smooth, glossy sauce.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď na teplých tanieroch, posypané ešte trochou korenia a syra. Cacio e pepe nepočká – po pár minútach omáčka zhustne a stuhne.
steps.en: Serve immediately on warm plates with a little more pepper and cheese. Cacio e pepe does not wait: within minutes the sauce thickens and sets.

description.sk: Janovské pesto z bazalky, píniových orieškov a parmezánu so zemiakmi a fazuľkami.
description.en: Genoese pesto of basil, pine nuts and parmesan, with potatoes and green beans.

steps.sk: Bazalku otrhaj, listy umy a dôkladne osuš – mokré listy pesto zriedia a stmavne. Píniové oriešky opraž na suchej panvici 2 minúty dozlatista a nechaj vychladnúť.
steps.en: Pick the basil leaves, wash them and dry them thoroughly; wet leaves make the pesto runny and dark. Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden and let them cool.

steps.sk: V mixéri krátkymi impulzmi rozmixuj cesnak, oriešky, bazalku a štipku soli, postupne prilievaj olivový olej a mixuj len dovtedy, kým nevznikne hrubšia pasta. Nakoniec lyžicou vmiešaj nastrúhaný parmezán; dlhé mixovanie bazalku zohreje a zhorkne.
steps.en: Pulse the garlic, nuts, basil and a pinch of salt in a blender, gradually adding the olive oil and blending only until you have a coarse paste. Finally stir in the grated parmesan with a spoon; long blending heats the basil and makes it bitter.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1 cm, fazuľky na 3 cm kúsky. Vo veľkom hrnci priveď do varu vodu so zvyšnou soľou, pridaj zemiaky a po 3 minútach cestoviny; 5 minút pred koncom varu pridaj fazuľky.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1 cm dice; cut the green beans into 3 cm lengths. Bring a large pot of water with the remaining salt to the boil, add the potatoes and after 3 minutes the pasta; add the beans 5 minutes before the end.

steps.sk: Odober si šálku vody z cestovín a všetko sceď. V mise premiešaj cestoviny so zeleninou, pestom a 4 až 5 lyžicami horúcej vody, kým pesto nevytvorí krémový obal. Pesto nezohrievaj na panvici, stratilo by farbu aj vôňu.
steps.en: Save a cup of the pasta water and drain everything. In a bowl, toss the pasta and vegetables with the pesto and 4 to 5 tablespoons of the hot water until the pesto turns into a creamy coating. Never heat pesto in a pan, as it loses its colour and scent.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď, posypané parmezánom. Zvyšné pesto zalej v pohári tenkou vrstvou oleja; v chladničke vydrží 5 dní a dá sa zamraziť v tvorítku na ľad.
steps.en: Serve straight away with extra parmesan. Cover leftover pesto in a jar with a thin layer of oil; it keeps in the fridge for 5 days and freezes in an ice cube tray.

title.sk: Pasta alla Norma s baklažánom a ricottou
title.en: Pasta alla Norma with aubergine and ricotta

description.sk: Sicílske cestoviny s opečeným baklažánom, paradajkovou omáčkou, bazalkou a ricottou.
description.en: Sicilian pasta with fried aubergine, tomato sauce, basil and ricotta.

steps.sk: Baklažány nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, premiešaj ich s ½ lyžičkou soli a nechaj 20 minút odkvapkať v sitku. Potom ich vytlač a osuš utierkou, aby nenasávali toľko oleja.
steps.en: Cut the aubergines into 2 cm cubes, toss them with ½ teaspoon of salt and leave them to drain in a colander for 20 minutes. Squeeze them and pat dry with a tea towel so they soak up less oil.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej 4 lyžice oleja a baklažány opekaj na stredne silnom ohni v dvoch dávkach 8 až 10 minút, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlatohnedé a vnútri krémové. Vyber ich na papierovú utierku.
steps.en: Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan and fry the aubergine in two batches over a medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown all over and creamy inside. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opeč nasekaný cesnak s čili 1 minútu, pridaj paradajky, ½ lyžičky soli a polovicu natrhanej bazalky a var 12 minút do hustej omáčky. Polovicu baklažánov vmiešaj do omáčky.
steps.en: Fry the chopped garlic and chilli in the remaining oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, ½ teaspoon of salt and half the torn basil and simmer for 12 minutes into a thick sauce. Stir half the aubergine into the sauce.

steps.sk: Cestoviny uvar vo vode so zvyšnou soľou al dente, sceď ich a premiešaj s omáčkou a trochou vody z cestovín.
steps.en: Cook the pasta al dente in water with the remaining salt, drain it and toss with the sauce and a splash of the pasta water.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ ich do tanierov, navrch daj zvyšné baklažány, lyžicu rozdrobenej ricotty a čerstvú bazalku. Omáčka s baklažánmi vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Divide between plates and top with the rest of the aubergine, a spoonful of crumbled ricotta and fresh basil. The aubergine sauce keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Kurča na poľovnícky spôsob (pollo alla cacciatora)

description.sk: Kuracie stehná dusené s paprikou, hubami, olivami, rozmarínom a paradajkami.
description.en: Chicken thighs braised with peppers, mushrooms, olives, rosemary and tomatoes.

steps.sk: Stehná posoľ polovicou soli, okoreň a zľahka obaľ v múke. Papriky nakrájaj na prúžky, cibuľu na polkolieska, huby na štvrtinky a cesnak na plátky.
steps.en: Season the thighs with half the salt and the pepper and dust them lightly in flour. Cut the peppers into strips, the onion into half-moons, the mushrooms into quarters and the garlic into slices.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici rozohrej olej a stehná opeč 5 minút z každej strany dozlatista. Vyber ich na tanier.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan and brown the thighs for 5 minutes on each side until golden. Set them aside on a plate.

steps.sk: Na výpeku opekaj cibuľu, papriky a huby 8 minút, pridaj cesnak a rozmarín a po minúte prilej víno. Nechaj ho 2 minúty povrieť a zoškrab výpek zo dna.
steps.en: Fry the onion, peppers and mushrooms in the pan juices for 8 minutes, add the garlic and rosemary and after a minute pour in the wine. Let it bubble for 2 minutes, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, olivy a zvyšnú soľ, vráť mäso, prikry a var na miernom ohni 25 minút. Mäso je hotové pri 74 °C, keď je mäkké a šťava z neho číra; omáčka má byť hustá.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, olives and remaining salt, return the chicken, cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes. It is done at 74 °C, tender with clear juices, and the sauce should be thick.

steps.sk: Podávaj s chlebom alebo cestovinami. Cacciatora je typické jedlo na druhý deň – v chladničke vydrží 3 dni a omáčka sa ešte zlepší.
steps.en: Serve with bread or pasta. Cacciatora is a classic next-day dish: it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and the sauce only gets better.

title.sk: Risi e bisi – benátska ryža s hráškom
title.en: Risi e bisi: Venetian rice and peas

description.sk: Jarná benátska ryža s hráškom, maslom a parmezánom, riedka takmer ako polievka.
description.en: A Venetian spring dish of rice and peas with butter and parmesan, loose enough to be almost a soup.

steps.sk: V hrnci priveď do varu 1,3 litra vody s bujónom a nechaj ho na najmenšom ohni. Štvrtinu hrášku rozmixuj s 200 ml vývaru na hladké pyré, ktoré dá ryži zelenú farbu a sladkosť. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno.
steps.en: Bring 1.3 litres of water with the stock cube to the boil and keep it on the lowest heat. Blend a quarter of the peas with 200 ml of the stock into a smooth purée, which gives the rice its green colour and sweetness. Chop the onion finely.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozpusti polovicu masla s olejom; ak chceš slaninu, opraž ju nakrájanú na kocky 3 minúty. Pridaj cibuľu a speň ju 5 minút do mäkka, ale nie do hneda.
steps.en: Melt half the butter with the oil in a wide pan; if using bacon, fry it diced for 3 minutes. Add the onion and soften it for 5 minutes without letting it brown.

steps.sk: Vsyp ryžu a 2 minúty ju opekaj za stáleho miešania, kým zrnká nie sú na okrajoch priesvitné. Prilej 2 naberačky horúceho vývaru a miešaj, kým ho ryža nevsiakne.
steps.en: Add the rice and toast it for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the grains turn translucent at the edges. Add 2 ladles of the hot stock and stir until it is absorbed.

steps.sk: Pridaj celý hrášok a pokračuj: vždy prilej naberačku vývaru a miešaj, kým nezmizne. Po 15 minútach vmiešaj hráškové pyré a var ďalšie 2 až 3 minúty. Ryža má byť riedšia než rizoto, takmer ako hustá polievka.
steps.en: Add the whole peas and carry on, adding a ladle of stock at a time and stirring until it disappears. After 15 minutes, stir in the pea purée and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more. It should be looser than a risotto, almost a thick soup.

steps.sk: Odstav, vmiešaj zvyšné maslo, parmezán a petržlenovú vňať, okoreň a nechaj 2 minúty prikryté odpočinúť. Podávaj hneď; ohrievaná ryža zhustne, preto pri prehrievaní prilej vývar.
steps.en: Take it off the heat, stir in the remaining butter, the parmesan and parsley, season with pepper and leave it covered for 2 minutes. Serve straight away; it thickens on reheating, so add stock when you warm it up.

title.sk: Domáce zemiakové gnocchi s paradajkovou omáčkou
title.en: Homemade potato gnocchi with tomato sauce

description.sk: Mäkké halušky zo zemiakov a múky v jednoduchej paradajkovej omáčke s bazalkou.
description.en: Soft potato and flour dumplings in a simple tomato and basil sauce.

steps.sk: Zemiaky umy a var v šupke 30 až 35 minút, kým sa do nich nôž zapichne bez odporu. Sceď ich a ešte horúce ošúp – suché zemiaky potrebujú menej múky a gnocchi budú ľahké.
steps.en: Scrub the potatoes and boil them in their skins for 30 to 35 minutes until a knife slides in without resistance. Drain and peel them while still hot; dry potatoes need less flour, which keeps the gnocchi light.

steps.sk: Zemiaky pretlač cez lis na zemiaky alebo ich jemne roztlač na doske a nechaj 5 minút odpariť. Pridaj vajce, lyžičku soli a väčšinu múky a rýchlo spracuj na mäkké cesto, ktoré sa už nelepí. Dlho ho nemies, inak bude tuhé.
steps.en: Press the potatoes through a ricer or mash them finely on the board and let them steam off for 5 minutes. Add the egg, a teaspoon of salt and most of the flour and quickly work into a soft dough that no longer sticks. Do not knead it for long or it turns tough.

steps.sk: Cesto rozdeľ na 4 časti, každú vyvaľkaj na pomúčenej doske na valček hrubý 2 cm a nakrájaj na 2 cm kúsky. Ak chceš ryhy, prevaľkaj ich po vidličke, omáčka sa na ne lepšie chytí. Gnocchi ukladaj na pomúčenú tácku.
steps.en: Divide the dough into 4, roll each piece on a floured board into a 2 cm thick rope and cut it into 2 cm pieces. For ridges, roll them over the back of a fork so the sauce clings better. Lay the gnocchi on a floured tray.

steps.sk: Na omáčku opeč na oleji nasekaný cesnak 1 minútu, pridaj paradajky, zvyšnú soľ a polovicu bazalky a var 15 minút do hustej omáčky.
steps.en: For the sauce, fry the chopped garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, the remaining salt and half the basil and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Gnocchi var po dávkach vo veľkom hrnci mierne vriacej vody. Keď vyplávajú na povrch, var ich ešte 1 minútu a dierovanou lyžicou ich prekladaj priamo do omáčky.
steps.en: Cook the gnocchi in batches in a large pot of gently boiling water. Once they float, give them 1 more minute and lift them with a slotted spoon straight into the sauce.

steps.sk: Jemne ich premiešaj s omáčkou, posyp parmezánom a zvyšnou bazalkou a podávaj. Surové gnocchi zamraz na tácke rozložené od seba a var ich potom priamo z mrazničky.
steps.en: Toss them gently in the sauce, sprinkle with parmesan and the rest of the basil and serve. Freeze raw gnocchi spread apart on a tray, then cook them straight from frozen.

title.sk: Parmigiana – zapekaný baklažán s paradajkami a mozzarellou
title.en: Melanzane alla parmigiana: baked aubergine with tomato and mozzarella

description.sk: Vrstvy opečeného baklažánu, paradajkovej omáčky, mozzarelly a parmezánu zapečené do zlatista.
description.en: Layers of roasted aubergine, tomato sauce, mozzarella and parmesan baked until golden.

steps.sk: Baklažány nakrájaj pozdĺžne na plátky hrubé 7 mm, posoľ ich ¾ lyžičky soli a nechaj 20 minút odstáť. Potom ich osuš papierovou utierkou.
steps.en: Slice the aubergines lengthways 7 mm thick, salt them with ¾ teaspoon of salt and leave for 20 minutes. Then pat them dry with kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Na omáčku opeč na lyžici oleja nasekaný cesnak 1 minútu, pridaj paradajky, zvyšnú soľ a korenie a var 20 minút, kým nezhustne. Nakoniec vmiešaj polovicu natrhanej bazalky.
steps.en: For the sauce, fry the chopped garlic in a tablespoon of oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, the remaining salt and the pepper and simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Finally stir in half the torn basil.

steps.sk: Plátky baklažánu potri zvyšným olejom a peč ich na plechu v rúre pri 220 °C 15 minút, kým nie sú mäkké a zlatisté. Pečené nasajú menej tuku ako vyprážané.
steps.en: Brush the aubergine slices with the remaining oil and roast them on a tray at 220 °C for 15 minutes until soft and golden. Roasted slices soak up less fat than fried ones.

steps.sk: Rúru nastav na 190 °C. Do zapekacej misy natri tenkú vrstvu omáčky a striedavo vrstvi baklažán, omáčku, natrhanú mozzarellu a parmezán, kým suroviny nespotrebuješ. Navrchu má byť omáčka, mozzarella a parmezán.
steps.en: Turn the oven down to 190 °C. Spread a thin layer of sauce in a baking dish and layer up the aubergine, sauce, torn mozzarella and parmesan until everything is used, finishing with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.

steps.sk: Zapekaj 30 minút, kým okraje nebublajú a syr nie je zlatohnedý. Nechaj parmigianu aspoň 15 minút postáť, aby sa vrstvy usadili a dala sa krájať.
steps.en: Bake for 30 minutes until bubbling at the edges with the cheese golden brown. Let the parmigiana stand for at least 15 minutes so the layers settle and it can be cut.

steps.sk: Podávaj s chlebom a zvyšnou bazalkou. Parmigiana je ešte lepšia na druhý deň, vlažná aj studená; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Serve with bread and the remaining basil. Parmigiana is even better the next day, warm or cold; it keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Ribollita – toskánska polievka z fazule, kapusty a chleba
title.en: Ribollita: Tuscan bean, cabbage and bread soup

description.sk: Hustá toskánska zeleninová polievka zahustená fazuľou a starým chlebom.
description.en: A thick Tuscan vegetable soup thickened with beans and stale bread.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, mrkvu a zeler nakrájaj na drobné kocky, zemiaky na kocky s hranou 1,5 cm, kapustu bez hrubých žiliek na rezance a cesnak nadrobno. Fazuľu sceď a polovicu roztlač na kašu.
steps.en: Dice the onion, carrots and celery small, cut the potatoes into 1.5 cm cubes, shred the cabbage without its thick ribs and chop the garlic finely. Drain the beans and mash half of them.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja a zeleninu na ňom opekaj na miernom ohni 10 minút. Pridaj cesnak, tymian, rozmarín a čili a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot and cook the vegetables gently for 10 minutes. Add the garlic, thyme, rosemary and chilli and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, zemiaky, kapustu, celú aj roztlačenú fazuľu, 1,5 litra vody a rozdrobený bujón. Priveď do varu a var prikryté na miernom ohni 40 minút, kým kapusta nie je úplne mäkká.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, potatoes, cabbage, the whole and mashed beans, 1.5 litres of water and the crumbled stock cube. Bring to the boil and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 40 minutes until the cabbage is completely soft.

steps.sk: Chlieb natrhaj na kúsky a vmiešaj ho do polievky. Var ešte 10 minút a občas premiešaj – chlieb sa rozpadne a polievka zhustne. Dochuť soľou a korením.
steps.en: Tear the bread into pieces and stir it into the soup. Simmer for 10 more minutes, stirring now and then, until the bread breaks down and the soup thickens. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Podávaj pokvapkanú zvyšným olivovým olejom. Názov znamená „prevarená“: v Toskánsku sa polievka na druhý deň znova zohreje a je ešte lepšia. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Serve drizzled with the remaining olive oil. The name means 'reboiled': in Tuscany the soup is reheated the next day, when it is even better. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Cestoviny s brokolicou, cesnakom a čili
title.en: Pasta with broccoli, garlic and chilli

description.sk: Lacné juhotalianske cestoviny: brokolica uvarená spolu s cestovinami, cesnakový olej a chrumkavá strúhanka.
description.en: A cheap southern Italian pasta: broccoli cooked with the pasta, garlic oil and crunchy breadcrumbs.

steps.sk: Brokolicu rozober na malé ružičky, hlúbik ošúp a nakrájaj na tenké plátky. Cesnak nakrájaj na tenké plátky.
steps.en: Break the broccoli into small florets, peel the stalk and slice it thinly. Slice the garlic thinly.

steps.sk: Na suchej panvici opraž strúhanku s lyžicou oleja a štipkou soli 3 minúty dozlatista a vysyp ju do misky – bude z nej chrumkavá posýpka.
steps.en: Toast the breadcrumbs in a dry frying pan with a tablespoon of oil and a pinch of salt for 3 minutes until golden, then tip them into a bowl for a crunchy topping.

steps.sk: Cestoviny var vo veľkom hrnci vody so zvyšnou soľou podľa návodu na obale; 4 minúty pred koncom pridaj k nim brokolicu. Odober šálku vody z cestovín a všetko sceď.
steps.en: Cook the pasta in a large pot of water with the remaining salt as the packet directs, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes. Save a cup of the pasta water and drain everything.

steps.sk: Na panvici zohrej zvyšný olej s cesnakom a čili na miernom ohni 2 minúty, kým cesnak nie je svetlozlatý. Pridaj cestoviny s brokolicou a pol šálky vody z cestovín a prehadzuj 2 minúty, kým sa brokolica čiastočne nerozpadne a neobalí cestoviny.
steps.en: Warm the remaining oil with the garlic and chilli in the pan over a low heat for 2 minutes until the garlic is pale gold. Add the pasta, broccoli and half a cup of the pasta water and toss for 2 minutes until the broccoli partly breaks down and coats the pasta.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj citrónovou šťavou, posyp chrumkavou strúhankou a podľa chuti parmezánom. Najlepšie chutí hneď; v chladničke vydrží 2 dni a strúhanku pridaj až pred jedlom.
steps.en: Sprinkle with the lemon juice and top with the crunchy breadcrumbs and some parmesan if you like. It is best eaten straight away; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days, with the crumbs added just before eating.

title.en: Chicken piccata with lemon butter sauce

description.sk: Tenké kuracie plátky v múke opečené dozlatista, s maslovou omáčkou z citróna a vína.
description.en: Thin floured chicken escalopes fried until golden, with a butter sauce of lemon and wine.

note.sk: ¼ lyžičky do vody na cestoviny
note.en: ¼ tsp for the pasta water

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia prekroj vodorovne na dva tenké plátky a medzi dvoma fóliami ich zľahka naklep na hrúbku 1 cm. Posoľ ich ½ lyžičkou soli, okoreň a obaľ v múke; prebytočnú múku oklep.
steps.en: Slice the chicken breasts horizontally into two thin escalopes and gently pound them between two sheets of cling film to 1 cm thick. Season with ½ teaspoon of salt and the pepper and dust in flour, shaking off the excess.

steps.sk: Špagety daj variť do vody so zvyšnou soľou podľa návodu na obale. Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej s tretinou masla na stredne silnom ohni.
steps.en: Put the spaghetti on to cook in water with the remaining salt as the packet directs. Heat the oil with a third of the butter in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat.

steps.sk: Mäso opekaj po dávkach 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie je zlatisté a vnútri má 74 °C – tenké plátky sú hotové rýchlo a dlhým pečením vyschnú. Prekladaj ho na teplý tanier.
steps.en: Fry the chicken in batches for 3 minutes on each side until golden and 74 °C inside; thin escalopes cook quickly and dry out if overcooked. Move them to a warm plate.

steps.sk: Na panvici speň nadrobno nasekaný cesnak 30 sekúnd, prilej víno, citrónovú šťavu a 100 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom a zoškrab výpek. Var 3 minúty, kým sa tekutina nezredukuje na polovicu.
steps.en: Soften the finely chopped garlic in the pan for 30 seconds, pour in the wine, lemon juice and 100 ml water with the crumbled stock cube and scrape up the browned bits. Boil for 3 minutes until reduced by half.

steps.sk: Stiahni panvicu z ohňa a po kúskoch vmiešaj zvyšné studené maslo, kým omáčka nezhustne a nezačne sa lesknúť. Vráť mäso, potri ho omáčkou, posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj so špagetami premiešanými s trochou omáčky.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and stir in the rest of the cold butter piece by piece until the sauce thickens and turns glossy. Return the chicken, spoon over the sauce, scatter with parsley and serve with the spaghetti tossed in a little of the sauce.

title.sk: Cestoviny s lososom, špenátom a smotanou

description.sk: Rýchle cestoviny so šťavnatými kockami lososa, špenátom, citrónom a kôprom.
description.en: Quick pasta with juicy salmon chunks, spinach, lemon and dill.

steps.sk: Cestoviny daj variť do veľkého hrnca vody s ½ lyžičkou soli podľa návodu na obale. Z lososa stiahni kožu, nakrájaj ho na kocky s hranou 2 cm a posoľ ho štipkou soli.
steps.en: Put the pasta on to cook in a large pot of water with ½ teaspoon of salt as the packet directs. Skin the salmon, cut it into 2 cm cubes and season with a pinch of salt.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej a lososa opekaj na stredne silnom ohni 3 minúty, opatrne ho obracaj. Keď je zvonka svetlý a vnútri ešte jemne sklovitý, prelož ho na tanier, v omáčke sa dovarí.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the salmon over a medium-high heat for 3 minutes, turning it gently. When it is pale outside but still slightly glassy within, move it to a plate; it will finish cooking in the sauce.

steps.sk: Na panvicu pridaj nasekaný cesnak, po 30 sekundách prilej smotanu a priveď do varu. Pridaj špenát a miešaj 1 minútu, kým nezvädne. Dochuť citrónovou kôrou a šťavou, zvyšnou soľou a korením.
steps.en: Add the chopped garlic to the pan and after 30 seconds pour in the cream and bring to the boil. Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute until wilted. Season with the lemon zest and juice, the remaining salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Scedené cestoviny pridaj do omáčky spolu s 3 lyžicami vody z cestovín a parmezánom, premiešaj a vráť lososa. Prehrej všetko ešte minútu – losos je hotový, keď sa rozpadá na lupienky.
steps.en: Add the drained pasta to the sauce with 3 tablespoons of the pasta water and the parmesan, toss and return the salmon. Heat for one more minute; the salmon is done when it flakes apart.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané kôprom a korením. Jedlo je najlepšie hneď; zvyšky vydržia 1 deň v chladničke.
steps.en: Serve sprinkled with dill and pepper. It is best eaten straight away; leftovers keep for 1 day in the fridge.

title.sk: Panzanella – toskánsky šalát s chlebom a paradajkami
title.en: Panzanella: Tuscan bread and tomato salad

description.sk: Letný šalát zo starého chleba nasiaknutého šťavou zo zrelých paradajok, s uhorkou a bazalkou.
description.en: A summer salad of stale bread soaked in ripe tomato juices, with cucumber and basil.

steps.sk: Starší chlieb natrhaj na kúsky s hranou 3 cm. Ak je čerstvý, nechaj ho 1 hodinu preschnúť na vzduchu – mäkký chlieb by sa v šaláte rozmočil na kašu.
steps.en: Tear the stale bread into 3 cm pieces. If it is fresh, leave it out to dry for 1 hour; soft bread would turn to mush in the salad.

steps.sk: Paradajky nakrájaj na veľké kúsky a daj ich do misy so soľou; nechaj ich 10 minút odstáť, aby pustili šťavu. Uhorku nakrájaj na polkolieska a červenú cibuľu na tenké plátky, ktoré na 5 minút namoč do studenej vody, aby stratili ostrosť.
steps.en: Cut the tomatoes into large chunks and put them in a bowl with the salt; leave for 10 minutes to release their juices. Slice the cucumber into half-moons and the red onion thinly, soaking the onion in cold water for 5 minutes to take off its bite.

steps.sk: Do šťavy z paradajok pridaj ocot, prelisovaný cesnak, olivový olej a korenie a rozšľahaj ich vidličkou na dresing.
steps.en: Add the vinegar, crushed garlic, olive oil and pepper to the tomato juices and whisk with a fork into a dressing.

steps.sk: Pridaj chlieb, uhorku, scedenú cibuľu, olivy a natrhanú bazalku a všetko premiešaj rukami. Nechaj 15 minút postáť, aby chlieb nasal šťavu, ale na okrajoch zostal chrumkavý.
steps.en: Add the bread, cucumber, drained onion, olives and torn basil and toss everything together with your hands. Leave it for 15 minutes so the bread soaks up the juices while staying crisp at the edges.

steps.sk: Podávaj pri izbovej teplote ako ľahký letný obed, najlepšie s veľmi zrelými paradajkami. Panzanella je najlepšia v deň prípravy; v chladničke chlieb zmäkne.
steps.en: Serve at room temperature as a light summer lunch, ideally with very ripe tomatoes. Panzanella is best on the day it is made; in the fridge the bread goes soft.

title.sk: Cestoviny s cuketou, ricottou a citrónom
title.en: Pasta with courgette, ricotta and lemon

description.sk: Opečená cuketa, krémová ricotta s citrónovou kôrou a mäta – rýchle letné cestoviny.
description.en: Golden fried courgette, creamy ricotta with lemon zest and mint; a quick summer pasta.

steps.sk: Cukety nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a cesnak nadrobno. Ricottu rozmiešaj s citrónovou kôrou, polovicou parmezánu, štipkou soli a korením.
steps.en: Slice the courgettes into thin half-moons and chop the garlic finely. Mix the ricotta with the lemon zest, half the parmesan, a pinch of salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Cestoviny daj variť do vody s ½ lyžičkou soli podľa návodu na obale.
steps.en: Put the pasta on to cook in water with ½ teaspoon of salt as the packet directs.

steps.sk: Na širokej panvici rozohrej olej a cukety opekaj na silnom ohni 6 až 8 minút, kým sa šťava neodparí a okraje nezačnú zlatnúť. Pridaj cesnak a čili a opekaj ešte minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and fry the courgettes over a high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until their juices evaporate and the edges turn golden. Add the garlic and chilli and fry for a minute more.

steps.sk: Odober šálku vody z cestovín, cestoviny sceď a pridaj ich k cuketám. Mimo ohňa vmiešaj ricottovú zmes a toľko vody z cestovín, aby vznikla krémová omáčka. Dochuť citrónovou šťavou a zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: Save a cup of the pasta water, drain the pasta and add it to the courgettes. Off the heat, stir in the ricotta mixture and enough pasta water to make a creamy sauce. Season with lemon juice and the remaining salt.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané zvyšným parmezánom a natrhanou mätou. Jedlo je najlepšie čerstvé; v chladničke vydrží 2 dni a pri ohrievaní prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Serve topped with the remaining parmesan and torn mint. It is best fresh; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days, with a splash of water when reheating.
